title: How Far Can It Go? On Intrinsic Gender Bias Mitigation for Text Classification

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures intrinsic gender bias in pretrained language models using Sentence Embedding Association Test (SEAT) and Log Probability Bias Score (LPBS), and develops a custom linear classifier probe to detect residual gender information in contextualized word embeddings. It also evaluates extrinsic gender bias in downstream text classification tasks (Bias-in-Bios and Jigsaw) by measuring True Positive Rate Difference (TPRD) and Counterfactual Fairness (CF).
